itens.titulo: [EDIT] Confirmed Issues
itens.texto:
Thank you for playing Toram Online.
We have confirmed issues regarding in-game systems, so please check the following details.
When the issues are fixed, we will announce it on our official website.
Bug Report
・Damage reduction remains low when the skill “Mighty Charge” is reused while stacks are accumulated.
・An issue where the skill “Fatebreaker” could be used together with the skill “Asura Aura”.
(The information written in the skill description is the intended behavior.)
・Under certain conditions, the players on Steam/Windows version are randomly logged out of the game.
・Mercenary/Partner skill cooldown is not working properly.
・Occasionally, the animation of the story mission "Journey for Reconstruction" does not play properly.
・Occasionally after the effect of the Minstrel Skill "Life Song" ends, the HP is not shown as originally designed.
・A bug where more than 2 monsters, such as Colon Commander and Miracle Potum that are supposed to only spawn one at a time on a map, appear at the same time even when a party has not been formed.
・A bug where unusual monsters' moves are seen under certain conditions.
・Character names not appearing correctly under certain conditions.
・Certain skills unintentionally wake sleeping monsters up when used on them.
・NPC that joins a battle doesn't move correctly in battle or when knocked out.
・When using Mononofu Skill: Shukuchi, the player character don't approach the target and the buff effect remains under certain conditions.
・Chat functions not working correctly under certain conditions.
・Motion that occurs when status ailments are inflicted is not activated under certain conditions.
・Abnormal damage occurs to boss monsters while they are in shell mode.
Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Phalanx Skills

Lv1
Skill Description
Shield Lancer Usable when no sub-weapon is equipped or when itis a shield.
Equips a shield temporarily upon activation.
Enters Spearshield Mode , allowing the use of attack skills
from the Phalanx skill tree and some Shield skills.
*Dual Shields cannot be used.
Survival Armor Learns how to handle heavy armor.
Guarantees a minimum amount of damage reduction when you Guard.
However, Survival Armor will be temporarily disabled
when inflicted with [Armor Break].
Lv2
Skill Description
Sharp Riposte Only usable in Spearshield Mode.
Reduces damage taken to 0 once, then deals damage to the target.
If damage is successfully reduced, this attack is guaranteed to hit.
Assault Lance Only usable in Spearshield Mode.
Charges toward the target (linear AoE).
Reduces all damage taken while charging toward the target and increases the power and Attack MP Recovery of your next normal attack.
Dragon Leap Only usable in Spearshield Mode.
Leaps forward to attack, shifting from defense to offense.
The longer Spearshield Mode is active, the more damage this attack deals.
You will then switch back to Halberd Mode.
Rampart Boosts all damage reduction and the minimum guaranteed
Guard Power for a short time.
Each time the user takes damage, including 0 damage , the ATK of the user and connected party members increases ( max 5 times ).
Lv3
Skill Description
Revolving Shields Only usable in Spearshield Mode.
Deploys 6 aura shields that are consumed when you take damage, reducing the damage received and dealing damage to nearby enemies.
Mighty Charge Only usable in Spearshield Mode.
Assumes a defensive stance and builds up energy
with each successful block ( max 10 ).
Press forward to unleash the accumulated energy in a linear attack, or press backward to cancel the skill and recover a small amount of the MP consumed.
Fatebreaker Unleashes the power to bend fate.
Normal attacks generate more aggro and always hit
while the effect is active. Your ATK and MATK also increase over time.
Reusing Fatebreaker ends its effect, but them increased ATK and MATK last for 3 minutes.
